ambiguity.detail: The identity of the 'late Duke' and why his survival matters is completely opaque.

verdict.hook_line: Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A nobleman learns a rumor that a scarred war veteran might actually be a powerful deceased Duke, sparking intense paranoia.
verdict.why_it_works: Jumping straight from a romantic confession into a high-stakes conspiracy thriller creates an irresistible narrative whiplash.
